$comment: Human-maintained annotations consumed by scripts/generate-data-model.js. Add EVERY column of a coach-facing table here; unclassified columns show ⚠️ in the doc and fail `npm run data-model:check`. Access values: coach-edit | app | system | read.

user_profile.purpose: The user's identity, preferences, and the AI/coach plan. The dashboard's main edit surface. `onboarding_profile_json` holds the whole plan (see JSON shapes below).

onboarding_profile_json.note: the full Onboard/action plan blob; edit via structured tooling, not raw — regeneration overwrites it

timezone.note: set by the app from the device

is_coach.note: marks coach accounts; set deliberately in Studio

human_coach_step_notes_json.note: coach free-text per step; keys step_1/step_2/step_3 (see lib/human-coach-step-notes.ts). Kept separate so plan regen never clobbers it

account_status.note: active|deactivated; admin/coach gate on app access

plan_status.note: workflow enum: 'AI drafted' → 'Coach reviewed' → 'Coach and client reviewed'

avatar_url.note: set by app upload to the avatars bucket

signup_code.note: acquisition attribution: the special_codes.code the user joined with (e.g. coach code), or NULL. Set once by the app at signup; stored as the literal code, not an FK

coaches.purpose: Coach accounts that can log into the dashboard.

coach_name.note: slug used to match onboarding config

password_hash.note: bcrypt; set/rotate via secure tooling only

full_name.note: display name (first token must match onboarding config key)

last_login_at.note: stamped by the dashboard on login

coach_user.purpose: Append-only log of coach + plan-tier assignments. The current row per user is WHERE is_current = true (the dashboard roster); older rows are the ai↔human history ordered by assigned_at. To change a user's tier/coach: set the live row is_current=false, then insert a new is_current=true row.

plan_tier_id.note: FK → plan_tiers.id; NULL = ai_only. The user's coaching plan tier (unrelated to training/nutrition/recovery plans)

is_current.note: marks the live assignment; exactly one true per user (partial unique index). Set false on the old row when changing tier/coach

assigned_at.note: when this assignment row was written; doubles as the tier-change timestamp for history

checkin_coach_with_user.purpose: Human coach check-in notes per user, written from the dashboard.

checkin_type.note: how the coach checked in: message | call | video | in_person (NULL = unspecified)

contextTables.user_nutrition_targets: Persisted macro/calorie targets the app derives from the plan. Coaches change these indirectly by editing the plan (step 2), not by writing this table.
contextTables.weekly_checkin_reports: Weekly metrics snapshot + LLM narrative. App-written; useful read context for coaches.
contextTables.workout_exercise_logs: Per-set exercise rows under a workout_log. App-written.
contextTables.body_composition_log: Weekly body-composition scans (weight, muscle %, fat %). App-written. photo_front_url/photo_side_url/photo_back_url are optional progress-photo public URLs in the 'body-photos' bucket; front is the angle the app renders above each weight-chart bar.
contextTables.daily_metrics: Canonical wearable metrics per day/source. Edge-written.
contextTables.user_provider_connections: Wearable OAuth state with encrypted tokens. Service-role only — anon reads the *_public view.
contextTables.special_codes: Pre-auth onboarding entry codes (coach/event/promo). Managed in Studio.
contextTables.plan_tiers: Catalog of coaching plan tiers (key, display_name, checkins_per_week). Referenced by coach_user.plan_tier_id. Add a future tier by inserting a row — no schema change. checkins_per_week is the expected human check-ins/week the dashboard uses to compute 'pending check-ins this week' = max(0, checkins_per_week − count(checkin_coach_with_user rows since Monday)); ai_only = 0. The app maps `key` to a localized name; `display_name` is the English label.

bucketNotes.avatars: user profile photos; avatar_url on user_profile points here
bucketNotes.social-posts: social post photos; photo_url on social_posts points here
bucketNotes.circle-images: forging circle cover photos; image_url on forging_circles points here
bucketNotes.body-photos: weekly body progress photos; photo_front_url/photo_side_url/photo_back_url on body_composition_log point here. Public-read by design (see Storage section) — paths are {userId}/{year}_W{week}_{angle}.jpg
